added: With Custom Figures on, a dialect can give one of your own new figures a name or a wording template of its own, starting from the figure's own wording and using its parameters as slots. A program matrix column for the figure takes the dialect's name too.
Deleting one of your new figures removes its name and wording from every dialect, and its column's place, name and hiding from Matrix columns.

`dialectUserFigureName`, `dialectUserFigureWording` and `dialectWithoutUserFigure` read and drop a dialect's `userFigure:<id>` entries; `FigureRenderer` uses them outside the canonical render, and `matrixColumnLabel` uses the name (#1023).
